items.title: Add job-plus-run proof metadata review guidance
items.context: Update Lattice reviewer guidance so quality review explicitly checks that server-authored proof keys cannot be trusted from either job.metadata or linked run.metadata when those fields are client-controlled or stale. Keep this as review guidance, not server business logic.

happy.desc: The quality reviewer prompt/checklist names both job.metadata and linked run.metadata for server-authored proof key checks.

edge.desc: The guidance is framed as a correctness review rule, not a broad optimization or product behavior change.

adversarial.desc: The guidance warns that checking only job.metadata or only run.metadata is insufficient for proof metadata spoofing review.

verificationEvidence.note: Smoke asserts the quality reviewer prompt contains both job.metadata and linked run.metadata proof metadata review phrases.
Guidance is narrowly scoped to proof/receipt/provider/run/job metadata semantics and framed as correctness review guidance, not broad optimization or product behavior.
Smoke asserts the phrase checking only one location is insufficient, rejecting job-only or run-only review coverage.

items.title: Add regression smoke for prompt coverage
items.context: Add or extend a smoke test that verifies generated reviewer prompt/registry content contains the job+run metadata proof review rule.

happy.desc: A smoke test fails if the quality reviewer prompt omits job.metadata.

edge.desc: A smoke test fails if the prompt omits linked run.metadata.

adversarial.desc: A smoke test fails if the prompt allows one metadata location to stand in for the other.

verificationEvidence.note: Prompt registry smoke fails if lattice-review-quality.md omits job.metadata from the proof metadata phrase set.
Prompt registry smoke fails if lattice-review-quality.md omits linked run.metadata from the proof metadata phrase set.
Prompt registry smoke fails if the prompt no longer says checking only one location is insufficient.

items.title: Write baseline comparison result for item 2
items.context: Create a derived result artifact under experiments/baselines/ for the proofMetadataReviewCoverage baseline dimension; do not rewrite the immutable baseline JSON.

happy.desc: The result artifact references baselineId, story id, and proofMetadataReviewCoverage.

edge.desc: The immutable baseline file remains unchanged.

adversarial.desc: The result artifact does not claim that reviewer guidance alone is receipt-backed production proof.
